item_short_desc: Rothco’s M-16 Clip Pouches offer a reliable and durable solution for carrying your .556 caliber magazines during range sessions. Featuring belt clips for easy attachment to your range or duty belt, these pouches provide quick access to your magazines when you need them most. The pouch is made from durable nylon to withstand years of use, ensuring your gear stays secure. A sure-lock pouch clip keeps your magazines in place, even during movement, while 2 additional side strap snaps allow for attaching extra accessories or gear.
